kraken-violet.$description: Kraken Violet — Violet supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

deep-iris.$description: Deep Iris — Dark surface backing for the brand radial gradient and darker brand moments

midnight-ink.$description: Midnight Ink — Dark surface backing paired with violet gradients, section-level dark accents

ink-black.$description: Ink Black — Primary text, headlines, icon strokes, and input borders — the dominant ink at 18,000+ occurrences

pure-white.$description: Pure White — Page canvas, card surfaces, input fills, and button text

linen-mist.$description: Linen Mist — Subtle off-white for alternating section bands and the hero background tint

fog-border.$description: Fog Border — Hairline dividers and disabled button borders

steel-slate.$description: Steel Slate — Secondary body text, icon tints, muted nav labels, secondary button text

ash.$description: Ash — Tertiary text and low-emphasis icon strokes

graphite.$description: Graphite — Hover and active states on dark elements, deep nav accents

lilac-wash.$description: Lilac Wash — Soft violet-tinted background for ghost buttons and tag highlights

bull-green.$description: Bull Green — Green supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

mint-badge.$description: Mint Badge — Light supporting surface for subtle backgrounds and section separation. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

bear-red.$description: Bear Red — Red supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

forest-seal.$description: Forest Seal — Green supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

kraken-product.$description: The single workhorse for body, nav, buttons, badges, inputs, and table rows — 16px/1.40 for primary body, 14px/1.43 for secondary text and nav, 12px/1.33 for badges and helper text, 10px/1.00 for micro-labels. Weight 500 carries emphasis (numbers, labels) without jumping to a heavy weight, keeping the interface uniformly lean.

kraken-brand.$description: Display and headline typeface — 48px for hero H1 at weight 700 with -0.0210em tracking, 36px for section H2s, 24px for card titles, 20px for subheadings. The custom cuts give a slightly condensed, slightly geometric profile that compresses nicely under negative tracking to read as one tight block rather than airy editorial type.

arial.$description: Arial — detected in extracted data but not described by AI
